pairs.question: Ain tandem? Etiam a Stoicis ista tractata sunt?
pairs.answer: Non sane nisi ab eo quem modo nominavi, et postea a magno homine et in primis erudito Panaetio.
pairs.derivation: Atticus asks (interrogative) whether the Stoics too treated these matters; Marcus answers directly. Speaker labels 'Atticus:' and 'Marcus:' stripped. Answer ends at first full stop ('Panaetio.'); what follows ('Nam veteres verbo tenus...') digresses into the history of who treated political philosophy, so it is cut.

pairs.question: Quid? Si nos tacemus, locus ipse te non admonet, quid tibi sit deinde dicendum?
pairs.answer: De iudiciis arbitror Pomponi; id est enim iunctum magistratibus.
pairs.derivation: Atticus asks (interrogative) what Marcus must speak of next; Marcus answers what topic comes next. Speaker labels stripped. Marcus's reply opens with the deflecting echo-question 'Mihine?' which does not answer, so the answer's start is advanced past it to the operative sentence. The answer runs to its first full stop (the internal semicolon is not a stop).

pairs.question: Quid tandem hoc loco est quod requiras?
pairs.answer: Quod ignorari ab iis qui in re publica versantur turpissimum puto.
pairs.derivation: Marcus asks (interrogative) what Atticus wants raised here; Atticus answers what he requires. Speaker labels stripped. Atticus's reply opens with the deflecting echo-question 'Egone?' which does not answer, so the answer's start is advanced past it to the operative sentence. Answer ends at first full stop ('puto.'); what follows ('Nam ut modo a te dictum est...') elaborates, so it is cut.
